snippet.title: OutRun 2 playthrough (Xbox) (1CC)
snippet.description:
OutRun 2 was released in the arcades in 2003. It was then ported to the Xbox in 2004, and the vanilla OutRun 2 is exclusive to this console. It features everything from the arcade game along with some extra cars and new challenges, which let you unlock more content (including the original 1986 OutRun).

This is a playthrough of the OutRun arcade mode, using the F50.
